name: mlforge-swagger
description: Standalone Swagger UI assets for mlforge

scripts.build: mkdir -p out && cp index.html out/index.html && cp openapi.yaml out/openapi.yaml && cp node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui.css out/swagger-ui.css && cp node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-bundle.js out/swagger-ui-bundle.js && cp node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js out/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js
